sample_unit: providers with complete Epic Signal time data

links.outcome: Change in EHR clinical review time per visit by baseline review time
links.effect: Average review time fell from 3:22 to 3:04 minutes per visit. Each extra minute of baseline review time was linked to an 8.6-second larger reduction (P = .046).
links.quote: Higher baseline review time was significantly associated with greater post-implementation reductions, with each additional minute at baseline linked to an 8.6-second decrease in review time (P = .046).

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world deployment of an AI clinical note summarization tool on EHR time and clinician perceptions, without testing an organizational safeguard or deployment practice variation.
